anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Shallow convex curvature with a large radius, showing a smooth transition from the dorsal ridge to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Elongated and narrow aspect ratio with a sharp, pointed distal tip extending significantly from the cranial inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: High-degree obtuse angle where the sloping melon contour meets the roughly horizontal dorsal surface of the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white punctate scarring (possibly from parasitic attachment or teeth rakes) distributed across the lateral body; visible notch on the trailing edge of the posterior fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: Complete caudal fluke visible at the posterior terminus, oriented horizontally with a distinct central notch.
